text: MD2001 Intended Learning Outcomes * Describe the basic structure and normal function of all the major body systems + Describe the basic cellular and molecular functions of discrete tissue types and cellular components + Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of how to undertake a range of clinical and communication skills (e.g. gathering information, handwashing, basic life support, blood pressure) « Discuss the fundamentals of good clinical practice (e.g. regulatory frameworks, professionalism, medical ethics, evidence-based medicine) * Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of dissection instruments and techniques to complement the concepts of anatomy * Describe the various immunological responses the body mounts against discrete pathogenic infections (https:/imedhandbook.st-andrews.ac.uk/bsc-hons-medicine-modules])
